summary: Agent-native CRM that builds a living customer context graph from every interaction.
editor_note: The stronger idea is structural: customer calls, email, calendar and Slack become a temporal context graph rather than another set of manually maintained CRM fields, so both people and agents can operate from it. A deterministic sandbox, SDK, continuous evals and open API/MCP/CLI surface make the agent boundary unusually inspectable for a CRM. Adoption and performance figures remain company reported, and the security of consolidating so much customer context deserves continued scrutiny.
investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Maverick Capital, Coatue, Audacious, Alumni Ventures, Greylock, Lightspeed Venture Partners

product_evidence.claim: The live product captures calls, email, calendar and Slack interactions into a shared customer record that agents use for prospecting, follow-up and deal work.
The financing announcement describes a temporal business world model, deterministic code sandbox, standardized SDK, continuous evaluations and API, MCP and CLI access.

market_context.primary_user: Sales and go-to-market teams that want agents to operate from current customer context.
market_context.differentiation: Builds a temporal context graph from communication streams and pairs it with an explicit agent harness rather than layering assistants over manually maintained CRM fields.
market_context.why_now: The Series A follows the company's first year of adoption as agent workflows increase demand for machine-readable customer context.

risks.claim: Company-reported signups do not establish durable active usage, and centralizing broad customer communications raises permissions, data-governance and evaluation demands.
risks.basis: VentureDex assessment based on Lightfield's official site, docs and company-supplied financing announcement.
